thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert -> inference-gateway-service: error-rate spike (5xx). Alerting threshold breached: 10m avg 5xx = 17%. auto-escalate in 5m.

pagerduty: ALERT: inference-gateway-service - High 5xx error rate
pagerduty: Triggered by policy inferred-error-rate > 15%

incident-bot: Root cause candidate: surge to /v1/generate with long-context requests; many streams saw backend timeouts. Suggest start checklist: verify recent deploys, check routing queue depth, look at model worker health.

sara (oncall): I'm on it. Checking latest deploys and canary status.

miguel: I just pulled deploy history — no full rollout in last 2 hours. There was a small canary at 4123456789 that showed increased mem pressure on rtxpools.

ashley: Observability: per-route 5xx concentrated on /v1/generate and /v1/chat/stream, with median latency jump from 120ms -> 950ms. Error body mostly "upstream timeout" or "worker OOM".

ken: Paging the runtime team. Infra metrics show GPU host mem utilization 92% on a subset of workers (eu-west-2). Could be a memory leak or big-context amplification.

sara (oncall): Quick mitigation: 1) shift traffic slice to secondary fleet 2) enable model-fallback to medium-small variant 3) temp max_prompt_tokens=4096 enforcement. I'm going to run 1 now.

infra-runner: Running router command to drain slice "eu-west-2a-slice-7" from active pool: 
```
redwood-router drain-slice --slice eu-west-2a-slice-7 --dry-run=false
```

infra-runner: drain started, rebalancing requests to warm pool in other regions. ETA 30s.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: auto-escalation in 3m. Current ack: none.

pagerduty: PagerDuty: alert acknowledged by sara (oncall)

sara (oncall): Confirmed drain 10% traffic off slice, error-rate marginally falling to 12% overall. Still high for some customers.

ashley: Customer impact: ~6 high-volume customers seeing >40% error rate; rest seeing 5-8%. Logged customers: acme-inc, travelmate, docspro. Notified CS to open customer tickets.

miguel: I'm toggling fallback to smaller model for the affected route. Command: 
```
redwood-config set route:/v1/generate model_fallback=redwood-medium --timeout=30s
```

miguel: Fallback enabled for /v1/generate. Monitoring.

ken: Also flipped off streaming for long-context clients to reduce concurrent KV memory: 
```
redwood-config set route:/v1/chat/stream streaming_enabled=false --selector=long_context
```

ken: Streaming off for long-context. This should reduce active worker memory.

ops-bot: Runbook step: if errors persist >10% after traffic shift and fallback, consider rolling back last canary.

sara (oncall): Checking canary 4123456789 — it is still at 1 node, status: running, mem 96% on that node. I'm aborting the canary now.

infra-runner: Aborting canary and cordoning node id rtx-1432: 
```
redwood-deploy abort-canary 4123456789
redwood-host cordon rtx-1432
```

infra-runner: Can confirm canary aborted, node cordoned.

ashley: After draining slice and fallback + canary abort, overall 5xx down to 6% in 4 minutes. Top affected customer errors dropping.

miguel: Adding temporary request cap for /v1/generate to limit heavy batch requests: 
```
redwood-rate set route:/v1/generate max_concurrent_requests=120
```

miguel: Cap applied. Should smooth the bursty long-run jobs.

sara (oncall): Good. TL;DR mitigation actions executed: drain eu-west slice, enable model fallback, disable streaming for long-context, abort canary, set concurrency cap. Asking infra to keep cordoned node offline for 2h while we investigate.

ken: I'll keep cordoned and start deeper host mem debug. Suspect allocator fragmentation + large attention cache load from long prompts. Grabbing heap profiles now.

pagerduty: Reminder: escalation to manager in 0m (resolved or acknowledged).

incident-bot: Pagerduty: incident acknowledged by sara (oncall) — escalation stopped.

ops-bot: Post-mitigation checks: 1) verify 5xx < 2% for 30m 2) run replay of recent failing requests in a test cluster 3) collect heap/profile/artifact bundle from rtx-1432.

ashley: Current customer impact: acme-inc errors now ~8% -> working with CS on targeted post-mortem. Travelmate and docspro back to <2%.

miguel: Scheduled test replay job: replayer-job-416789-test queued against isolated cluster. Will start in 10m.

sara (oncall): I'll keep this thread open during observation window. If numbers hold for 30m, we'll close. Otherwise, we'll escalate to oncall+runtime lead.

infra-runner: Collected heap profiles and attached to internal blob: https://internal.blob/redwood/416789/heapprofiles (linked to incident ticket).

ken: Early heap diff shows large arena allocations tied to attention cache growth for very long input sequences. Adding an immediate limiter for attention cache size per session.

miguel: Attention-cap limiter pushed as feature-flag: 
```
redwood-feature-flag set attention_cache_limit_per_session=1GB --env=prod
```

miguel: Flag enabled in prod. Monitoring for regressions.

sara (oncall): 5xx is stable at ~1.3% after all mitigations for last 7 minutes. Keeping observation. Good job team. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Reminder: create follow-up with action items: detailed RCA (allocator/attention cache), post-mortem with customer impact notes, and plan for permanent fix or quantization/eviction heuristics.

sara (oncall): I'll open PD incident ticket and assign RCA to miguel + ken. Setting follow-up meeting in 60m.

incident-bot: This thread will be auto-archived if no messages in 2 hours.

sara (oncall): Closing note: No rollback required beyond aborted canary. We mitigated without major customer outage. Will post final postmortem when RCA done.
